transcript.text: Alright everyone, we're moving the public GraphQL API from pilot to general production traffic on Monday. As the decision-maker on the production API policy, I want to get the readiness review completed before we finalize anything. The current draft has 300 requests per minute with a burst of 30, permits schema introspection, allows query depth 12, and has no tenant-specific rate tier. I'd like to hear from platform, SRE, security, and customer success before I make the final call. Who wants to start?
